points.name: Main Stage – Warehouse 1
points.description: The big red-brick warehouse by the river. Keynotes, the panel and the closing party. 600 seats; doors open 15 minutes before each session.

points.name: Room A – Tile House
points.description: Talk room in the upper stone house. Engineering talks and the hands-on workshops. 80 seats, laptops welcome.

points.name: Room B – Cork House
points.description: Talk room in the lower stone house. Product, design and AI talks. 80 seats.

points.name: Expo Hall
points.description: Glass pavilion with 30 sponsor and startup stands, live demos and the job board.

points.name: River Terrace
points.description: Wooden deck on the Tagus with coffee, juices and deck chairs. The networking spot between talks, with a view of the bridge.

points.name: Food Court
points.description: Food trucks and picnic tables: bifanas, salads, vegetarian bowls and pastéis de nata. Lunch is included with your badge.

points.name: Registration Desk
points.description: Pick up your badge here with the QR code from your ticket. Lost and found, Wi-Fi details and accessibility help.

points.name: Main Gate
points.description: Entrance through the old stone arch on the riverside avenue. Tram 15 stops right outside.

points.name: Toilets
points.description: Toilets next to the main gate, one of them accessible. More toilets inside Warehouse 1.

points.name: First Aid
points.description: Medical volunteers in the white tent all day. In an emergency, call 112.
